When the notes come from Washington it is the government that answers them, and the Supreme Command has learned since the summer that it is told what it may do. The army asks for nothing in its own name. The ministers who sign are the ministers who have governed since 1917. They can say to a Reichstag that has been consulted what the army can and cannot do.+3MANPOWER -6MUNITIONS -1HOME FRONT Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. The request goes forward from a Chancellor who still governs, and the later claim that civilians betrayed the army has less to feed on. What actually happened: Bethmann Hollweg was forced out in July 1917, in the crisis over the Reichstag's peace resolution, at the insistence of the Supreme Command, and the governments that followed were weaker. Prince Max of Baden became Chancellor on 3 October 1918 and the request to President Wilson went out in the first days of that month.
